description: SDEM's starting pattern for a payment initiation solution: what such a design has and how its parts connect, in all four layers. Shipped with SDEM; a person includes it in a workspace's profile (sdem profile include sdem:sdem-pattern-payment-initiation.json). It applies to a design that uses BIAN's service domain Payment Order Initiation, and to no other. Every part is a warning — something still to decide, never a failed check. A part SDEM cannot tell apart by structure (the key store) is named by a person with conforms_to; SDEM never guesses which record it is. An organisation with its own pattern for payment initiation includes that instead.

pattern.title: Payment initiation
pattern.source: BIAN 14.0.0 service domains Payment Order Initiation, Party Authentication and Fraud Evaluation; the New Zealand Payment Initiation API standard v2.3.3 (payment consents, idempotency) — cited, not copied; ArchiMate 3.2; docs/design/sdem-completeness-design.md (CPL-08)

roles.label: Process that receives the payment
roles.reasoning: the business step that takes the payment order — what the solution is for

roles.label: Component that handles the payment
roles.reasoning: software realises the service domain; without it the payment is handled by nothing

roles.label: Records of the consent, the payment and duplicate protection
roles.reasoning: a payment is made under a recorded consent, is itself recorded, and a repeated request must be recognised (idempotency) — three records

roles.label: Database the records are stored in
roles.reasoning: the records are durable: they are stored on a platform

roles.label: Party Authentication (BIAN)
roles.reasoning: the customer is authenticated and authorises the consent before any payment is taken

roles.label: Process that captures and authorises the consent
roles.reasoning: the business step in which the customer agrees

roles.label: Fraud Evaluation (BIAN)
roles.reasoning: the payment is screened for fraud before the account is debited

roles.label: Process that screens the payment for fraud
roles.reasoning: the business step that screens the payment — it comes before the debit

roles.label: API payment providers call
roles.reasoning: payment initiation is offered to third parties over an internet-facing API

roles.label: API operations: create and read a consent, create and read a payment
roles.reasoning: the least a payment initiation API offers

roles.label: Component that offers the API
roles.reasoning: an interface belongs to the component that offers it — here the ingress

roles.label: Audit record of decisions
roles.reasoning: who was let in, and what was refused, is kept

roles.label: Edge platform the API is exposed through
roles.reasoning: what faces the internet sits in a DMZ, not among the applications

roles.label: Key or secret store
roles.reasoning: signing keys and client secrets are held apart from the applications that use them
